content: शृध् I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (but <ab>Paras.</ab> also in the Second Future, Aorist and Conditional) (शर्धते) To break wind downwards. --II. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (शर्धति-ते) .²1 To moisten, wet. .²2 To cut off. --III. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (शर्धयति-ते) .²1 To strive. .²2 To take, grasp. .²3 To insult (as by breaking wind), mock, ridicule.
